versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the manage-channels skill for BulkPublish.
- Enables listing connected social media channels and checking their status.
- Provides tools to view channel health, options, and handle channel sets via REST API.
- Supports popular platforms including Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and more.
- Includes guidance on channel set operations, token status, LinkedIn account types, and mention search behavior per platform.
